purpose: Central registry for property evidence fixture impact events and their current revalidation state.
registry_rules: Every material fixture impact event must have a unique event ID.
Registry state is derived from the impact event and dependency map.
An impact event cannot establish live property evidence or change legal-source status.
Open impact events remain visible until revalidation is completed, superseded, or explicitly blocked.
closure_requirements: All required dependent tests have a new validation result.
Any provenance or privacy review has passed.
Affected pathway validation status has been updated.
The impact event records the resulting validation run IDs.
No unresolved critical fixture dependency remains.
guardrails: Registry status is technical validation governance, not a legal confidence score.
A REVALIDATED fixture does not mean the underlying legal proposition is legally verified.
Synthetic fixture events remain isolated from production legal evidence.
No event may claim live official-record retrieval without a real retrieval record.
